text.text_excerpt: This place is among the best barbecue I've tasted in Louisiana. The meat was near perfectly cooked, the portions are huge, and the sauce is homemade and has an incredible flavor. I couldn't decide what to get, so I got the sampler, brisket, pulled pork, and ribs. I could hardly eat much after I got past the ribs. And they use good meat too, the ribs where nice and big and had just the right amount of fat. You could probably just order three and be plenty full. This place is famous for the cochon de lait po boy which they sell at Jazz Fest, apparently under the name "Love At First Bite". The BBQ is fantastic. We had the baby back ribs and chicken. Both were cooked to perfection. Each came off the bone. And w wee juicy. They had a smoke taste but not over whelming. Also loved their potato salad which is a light mayo based And greens cooked down with the smoked pork. Save room for the peach cobble just awesome. This place is a gem in New Orleans

Oh wow. If you like barbeque, you will LOVE this place. It has some awesome stuff. The brisket is fantastic and tender, the ribs fall off the bone and are seasoned to perfection, the chicken is always perfectly cooked and never dry. The only reason I didn't give them a 5 rating is simply because the sides that they serve here are all way too salty. But i just skip the sides and eat the meat! If you haven't been yet, you need to go and bring everyone you know. It is a little out of the way (unless you live in New Orleans East) but it is well worth it.
